description: This PHP source file defines the PimDefinedReportAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing PIM (Personal Information Management) reports within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving detailed information about defined reports, utilizing various services, models, and validation rules.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportAPI
classes.description: Defines the API endpoints for managing PIM (Personal Information Management) reports, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving detailed reports within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all defined PIM reports, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new PIM defined report, setting report parameters and saving it via the report generator service.

methods.name: setParamsToPimDefinedReport
methods.description: Populates a Report entity with data from the API request, setting its name, group, filter usage, and type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method, including optional filters and sorting parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified PIM reports based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the deletion operation, ensuring valid IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific report by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single report.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing report, with transaction management to ensure data integrity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating reports, including ID validation and required fields.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules used in create and update operations, validating report name, include type, fields, and criteria.
